messages:
anya: Quick design check: proposing denser action row for compact dashboard cards. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789. problem: icon baseline feels low and focus ring is clipped inside card. thoughts?

mike: avoid fixed heights if possible. screenshot pls. :eyes:

anya: screenshot: https://imgur.com/compact-snip. current test CSS: .action { padding: 4px 6px; height: 28px; } .icon { transform: translateY(-2px); }

jordan: 28px visual height ok, but touch-target should be 44px. use invisible hit wrapper to preserve tap size.

lee: agree. also don't rely on translateY for icons. use inline-flex + align-items:center and set svg dims. e.g. .action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px }

mike: focus clipping likely from .card overflow:hidden. options: move actions to overflow-visible layer or use outline-offset. moving is safer.

anya: good. i'll prototype wrapper with overflow-visible and hit padding.

jordan: copy nit: change "Run eval" -> "Run evaluation" for clarity. remember i18n.

design-bot: token created: spacing.compact=6px; spacing.touch=10px; toast.duration.medium=2200ms. PR: #512. :robot_face:

mike: QA reminders: test RTL, long translations, and visual regen snapshots for default/long/icon-only variants.

anya: will update Figma, add tokens, and open a small PR. aiming for next sprint. thanks all.
